def glass(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return {(i,j):al[i][j] for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37)}
def diff(g1,g2):
    return sorted([(i,j,g1[(i,j)],g2[(i,j)]) for (i,j),v in g2.items() if g1[(i,j)]!=v])
# Current state: C (upright), selection=orange

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':3,'col':40},{'action':'SPACE'}])
g1=glass(current_frame)
c_region=diff(g0,g1)
print("C region (purple pour):", len(c_region))
print("rows:", sorted(set(x[0] for x in c_region)))
print("cols per row:", {r:sorted(j for x in c_region if x[0]==r) for r in sorted(set(x[0] for x in c_region))})
